entries.m: to rove about idly, gossiping and sight-seeing
entries.n: Wright says it still has this meaning in some dialects.

entries.m: to rove about without any good purpose, gossiping, sight-seeing and the like
entries.n: Still used in this sense in some dialects.
Wright says it is almost obsolete in this sense.

entries.m: a rowing barge with a low deck

entries.n: An old form, from Latin, meaning a place for storing grain.
